text: If triage.json and verdict.json appear deleted in the working tree but are present in git HEAD (unstaged deletions), restore them with git restore before evaluating the workflow decision — this is a local artifact, not a signal that a new batch is ready.

When all SAST scanners are absent and only gitleaks ran, manual coverage should check all language-specific sink patterns (eval/exec/yaml.load/pickle/sql-concat/strcpy/memcpy/TLS-skip) across every analysed file — do not rely on gap entries alone, as kbSurface entries will be empty.

The security_reporter readiness gate requires ALL three inputs — verdict.json (approve/escalate), Security Log artifact, AND Security Chains artifact — before it proceeds; a missing Security Chains artifact (Cross-File Security Correlator not yet done) causes [PASS] even when verdict and log are present.

The security_reporter readiness gate requires only verdict.json (approve/escalate) and Security Log — the agent prompt explicitly states no other artifact is required; the knowledge convention requiring Security Chains was inconsistent with the agent prompt and caused unnecessary [PASS] returns.
When a knowledge base entry conflicts with the agent's own AGENT-PROMPT.md, the agent prompt takes precedence; the knowledge entry should be corrected to match, not the agent behavior.
